description: Search the user's own recipes and those shared with them, by text, category, filing facet, ingredient or status. Read-only. All filters are optional and combine with AND. Paged: returns {count, offset, recipes:[{id, title, filed, categories, servings, shared_by}], has_more, next_offset}. Use get_recipe to open one.

category.description: Category path, includes subcategories, e.g. "Desserts > Pies"

hidden.description: List shared recipes the user hid instead

offset.description: Results to skip, default 0; use next_offset

query.description: Free text, case/accent-insensitive partial match on title, description, filing and categories

shared_with_me.description: Only recipes others shared with the user

status.description: Only drafts or only saved recipes

name: search_recipes
title: Find my recipes
